name: Luanti
title: Luanti: free Minecraft alternative
hook: Minecraft charges you thirty bucks to build your own block worlds. This game does it for free.

features.intro: You pick a game, then start playing.
features.say: Survive and build, solve puzzles, or jump into action.
Play solo, with friends, or online with dozens of players.
Over three thousand free mods add new items and animals.

caption:
Minecraft costs $29.99. Luanti lets you build your own block worlds for free 🧱

✅ Pick from many free games: survive, build, solve puzzles
✅ Play solo, with friends, or on online servers
✅ Over 3,000 free mods on ContentDB
✅ No subscription, no paywall, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux · Android
ℹ️ Luanti is an engine, not Minecraft. On first launch you install a game from the built-in ContentDB browser. Minecraft price is the one-time PC Java & Bedrock price

Comment "BLOCKS" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
